name: contextlang
description: Teaches you a language over time by weaving a few words, then phrases, then whole sentences of it into Claude's replies. No lessons, no study mode: it just works.

target_language.title: Language to learn
target_language.description: The language ContextLang weaves into replies, by name (Spanish, French, Japanese, Korean, ...). Spanish ships with a curated word pack; other languages get a pack generated on first use.

native_language.title: Your language
native_language.description: The language you already speak. Replies stay in this language until the target language has earned its way in.

age.title: Your age (optional)
age.description: Leave at 0 to skip. Younger and older learners get a gentler density and more repetition, which is what the spacing research supports.

pace.title: Pace
pace.description: How quickly new words arrive and how dense each reply gets. steady follows the research defaults.

marker_style.title: Marker style
marker_style.description: How a translated word stands out: bold gives 'questions **[preguntas]**'; italic gives 'questions *[preguntas]*'; code gives 'questions `[preguntas]`' (the terminal colors inline code); brackets gives plain 'questions [preguntas]'.

show_band.title: Show progress band
show_band.description: Draw a one-line band above the prompt with your level and word count.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Turn ContextLang off without losing progress. /contextlang pause does the same for one session.
